general.title: General
general.intro: Grouped app switcher overlay for Alt-Tab style navigation. Global hotkeys and custom actions stay outside the core plugin and are wired through Hyprland or scripts.

groupByApp.label: Group windows by app
groupByApp.description: When enabled, multiple windows from the same app appear as one item. Disable it for normal per-window switching.

enterGroupedWindowSelection.label: Enter grouped windows
enterGroupedWindowSelection.description: When enabled, the enter-group keybind opens the selected app group so you can choose the exact window to focus.

currentMonitorOnly.label: Current monitor only
currentMonitorOnly.description: When enabled, Tabber only shows windows from the monitor where the overlay was opened.

requirePointerMovementForHoverSelection.label: Require pointer movement for hover selection
requirePointerMovementForHoverSelection.description: When enabled, a stationary mouse cannot change the initial Tabber selection. Hover only starts affecting selection after the pointer moves.

preview.title: Designer preview

enabled.label: Enable designer preview
enabled.description: Show a live sample switcher in settings while you tweak the layout. This is intended for design work and screenshots.

preview.hint: The preview uses sample windows and updates from your unsaved draft settings.

width.label: Container width
width.description: Minimum switcher width in pixels. Set 0 to keep automatic width.

padding.label: Container padding
padding.description: Inner padding around the header and cards between 8 and 48.

linked.label: Link container padding sides
linked.description: When enabled, changing one container padding value updates all four sides.

show.label: Show header
show.description: Show the header row above the switcher cards.

alignment.label: Header alignment
alignment.description: How the header title and count are aligned.

text.label: Header text
text.description: Custom text shown in the header when it is enabled.

padding.label: Header padding
padding.description: Extra padding around the header row between 0 and 36.

linked.label: Link header padding sides
linked.description: When enabled, changing one header padding value updates all four sides.

showWindowCount.label: Show window count
showWindowCount.description: Display the selected group window count in the header badge.

cardGap.label: Card gap
cardGap.description: Spacing between cards and title slots between 0 and 48.

iconSize.label: Icon size
iconSize.description: Icon size inside each card between 24 and 96.

titleVisibility.label: Window title visibility
titleVisibility.description: Choose when window titles are shown below the cards.

titleTruncationMode.label: Title truncation mode
titleTruncationMode.description: How long titles are shortened when there is not enough space.

help.title: Tabber hotkeys are set in your Hyprland config, not here in the plugin settings.
help.description: Choose any Hyprland keybinds you want and point them at the Tabber global actions, then reload Hyprland.
help.actionsNote: Actions are defined by ID and script. Overlay shortcuts are optional and only apply while Tabber is open.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Configure optional integrations with other plugins. Integrations are only active when the target plugin is installed and enabled.

veil.title: Veil
veil.description: Controls how Tabber presents and restores Veil-managed windows.
veil.statusMissing: Veil is not installed or not discovered by Noctalia. Install and enable it before using this integration.
veil.statusDisabled: Veil is installed but not enabled in Noctalia. Enable it before using this integration.

enabled.label: Enable Veil integration
enabled.description: Show Veil-hidden windows in Tabber and restore them from the overlay.

highlightHiddenCards.label: Tint hidden cards
highlightHiddenCards.description: Apply a different color treatment to Veil-hidden entries in Tabber.

hiddenCardAccentColor.label: Hidden card accent color
hiddenCardAccentColor.description: Optional hex color for Veil-hidden cards. Leave empty to derive it from the current Noctalia theme.
